verdict.rationale: Metronome is a usage-based billing SaaS platform, and a built-in AI assistant is a plausible feature for this kind of product, so the axis applies. The evidence pack documents APIs, SDKs, webhooks, an event explorer and an llms.txt file, but nothing shows an in-product AI assistant that users can delegate tasks to. The llms.txt file and the OpenAPI spec help external agents consume the docs and API; they are not a built-in assistant.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can delegate tasks to a built-in AI assistant inside the product
